sloka: संह्लादो धूमकेतुश्च महादंष्ट्रो घटोदरः ।जम्बुमाली महाह्रादो विरूपाक्षश्च राक्षसः ।। ७.२७.२९ ॥
transliteration: saṁhlādo dhūmaketuśca mahādaṁṣṭro ghaṭodaraḥ ।jambumālī mahāhrādo virūpākṣaśca rākṣasaḥ ।। 7.27.29 ॥

translations.english: Also present were Samhlada, Dhumaketu, Mahadamshtra, Ghatodara, Jambumali, Mahahrada, and the rakshasa Virupaksha.
